title: 1946. Largest Number After Mutating Substring

examples.explanation: Replace the substring "1": - 1 maps to change[1] = 8. Thus, "132" becomes "832". "832" is the largest number that can be created, so return it.
Replace the substring "021": - 0 maps to change[0] = 9. - 2 maps to change[2] = 3. - 1 maps to change[1] = 4. Thus, "021" becomes "934". "934" is the largest number that can be created, so return it.
"5" is already the largest number that can be created, so return it.
